name: @serenedb/docs-search-embed
description: SereneDocsSearch as a single <script> tag — no build step, no framework

scripts.build: tsup src/index.tsx --format iife --global-name SereneDocsSearch --clean --minify --out-dir dist --define.process.env.NODE_ENV \"production\" && mv dist/index.global.js dist/serene-docs-search.js && cp ../react/src/styles.css dist/serene-docs-search.css
